UpdateRollRequest.description: The details to change. A detail left out stays as it is; null clears it. A roll number another roll has is refused with an issue on `roll`.

number.description: The new frame number, or null to clear it.

UpdateFrameDetailsRequest.description: Gives every frame listed the same camera, lens or events of its own; a frame's film stock is always its roll's (D45). A detail left out stays as each frame has it; null goes back to the roll's.

number.description: The new frame number, or null to clear it.

rating.description: 1 to 5 stars, or null to clear the rating.

camera.description: The frame's own camera, or null to use its roll's again.

event.description: The frame's own event, or null to use its roll's again.

toScan.description: Whether this frame is marked for a higher-resolution scan.

shot.description: The frame's own date shot, or null to use its roll's again.

defaultVersion.description: The version to show for the frame, one of its own, or null to show its first (D46).

UpdateFrameRequest.description: The details to change; a detail left out stays as it is.

FrameDetails.description: The details a frame ends up with, inherited from the archive and its roll (design section 6), each with where it came from. A detail set nowhere is left out.

kind.description: scan: ready to view, at any resolution; raw-scan: the negative or slide as scanned, not yet processed; final: processed and edited.

UpdateVersionRequest.description: How the version is turned when shown, or what kind it is; its file is never changed. A detail left out stays as it is.

CreateCameraRequest.description: Its slug is made from its make and model.

type.description: What kind of picture the film gives.
What kind of picture the film gives.

CreateFilmStockRequest.description: Its slug is made from its make and name.

CreateLensRequest.description: Its slug is made from its make, name, focal length and aperture.

name.description: What the event is called; its slug is made from it.

UpdateEventRequest.description: The details to change. A detail left out stays as it is; a null date clears it. The slug never changes.

author.description: Who took the photographs; frames inherit it.

copyright.description: The copyright notice; frames inherit it.

folder.description: The FilmFile folder's absolute path: read-only, chosen when FilmFile starts (by the desktop app, or FILMFILE_FOLDER) and never set through the API. The one absolute path any response carries (D64).

CreateSettingsRequest.description: Sets FilmFile up, once (D43). The FilmFile folder can’t be set here.

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: The details to change. A detail left out stays as it is; null clears the copyright. The author can’t be cleared, and the FilmFile folder can’t be set here.
